mapper.select: select PFI, CLIA, LAB_NAME, ADDRESS, CITY, STATE, ZIP, COUNTRY, LAFT_STAFF, CLA.APPROVAL_STATUS_DESC from lab_physical_facility lpf, CODED_LAB_APPROVAL_STATUS cla where PFI = #{userEnteredPfi} and LPF.APPROVAL_STATUS_CODE = CLA.APPROVAL_STATUS_CODE (+)
select count(ACCESSION_NUMBER) count from STD_HIV_ECLRS_DOC where ACCESSION_NUMBER = #{accessionNo}
mapper.insert:
insert into LAFT_CLEP_AUDIT_ACCESSION_DATA (SURVEY_NUMBER, SERIAL_NO, ACCESSION_NUMBER, COLLECTION_DATE, TEST_TYPE_HIV_IMM, TEST_TYPE_HIV_NAT, TEST_TYPE_CD4, TEST_TYPE_CUL, TEST_TYPE_SUPP_IMM, TEST_TYPE_RES,TEST_TYPE_OTH, REPORTED_IN_NYEHMS, RESOLVED, DATE_RESOLVED, COMMENTS, LAFT_STAFF )
select #{surveyNumber}, #{accessionVO.accessionSerialNo,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{accessionVO.accessionNo,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, FN_TO_DATE(#{accessionVO.collectionDate,jdbcType=DATE},'MM/DD/YYYY'), #{accessionVO.hivImmunoassay,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accessionVO.hivNAT,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accessionVO.cd4,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accessionVO.cluture,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accessionVO.supImmunoassay,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accessionVO.genotypicResistance,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accessionVO.other,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accessionVO.resultRptNyehms,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accessionVO.resolved,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FN_TO_DATE(#{accessionVO.dateResolved,jdbcType=DATE},'MM/DD/YYYY'), #{accessionVO.comments,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accessionVO.laftStaff,jdbcType=VARCHAR} from dual
mapper.select: SELECT survey_number, To_Char(receive_date, 'MM/DD/YYYY') receive_date, ls.pfi, clia, lab_name, lpf.approval_status_code, cla.approval_status_desc, laft_staff, review_completed, review_completed_by, To_Char(review_completed_date, 'MM/DD/YYYY') review_completed_date, To_Char(survey_date, 'MM/DD/YYYY') survey_date, To_Char(create_date, 'MM/DD/YYYY') create_date , address, city, state, zip, country , CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM laft_clep_audit_accession_data a WHERE a.survey_number = ls.survey_number) THEN 'Y' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laft_clep_audit_accession_data a WHERE a.survey_number = ls.survey_number AND a.accession_number IS NOT NULL AND Nvl(reported_in_nyehms, 'N') != 'Y') > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END attention_needed FROM laft_clep_audit_survey_form ls, lab_physical_facility lpf, coded_lab_approval_status cla WHERE ls.pfi = lpf.pfi AND lpf.approval_status_code = cla.approval_status_code (+) ORDER BY survey_number DESC

select SURVEY_NUMBER surveyNumber, ls.PFI userEnteredPfi, TO_CHAR(SURVEY_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') labDateOfSurvey, SURVEYOR labSurveyorName, TO_CHAR(RECEIVE_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') faxReceivedDate, INST_BASED_REPORTABLE_HIV insBasedHivTest, LAB_USES_ECLRS rptNysDohByEclrs, LAB_USES_REF_LAB labRefLabForTest, REFERENCE_PFI labRefPFI, lpf.CLIA pfiLabClia, lpf.LAB_NAME pfiLabName, lpf.ADDRESS pfiLabAddress, lpf.CITY pfiLabCity, lpf.STATE pfiLabState, lpf.ZIP pfiLabZip, lpf.COUNTRY pfiLabCountry, lpf.LAFT_STAFF pfiLabLaftStaff, CLA.APPROVAL_STATUS_DESC pfiLabApprovalStatus, reflab.LAB_NAME refLabName, reflab.CITY refLabCity, reflab.STATE refLabState, REVIEW_COMPLETED reviewCompleted, REVIEW_COMPLETED_BY reviewCompletedBy, TO_CHAR(REVIEW_COMPLETED_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') reviewCompletedDate from LAFT_CLEP_AUDIT_SURVEY_FORM ls, lab_physical_facility lpf, lab_physical_facility reflab, CODED_LAB_APPROVAL_STATUS cla where ls.SURVEY_NUMBER = #{surveyNo} and ls.pfi = lpf.pfi and ls.REFERENCE_PFI = reflab.pfi (+) and LPF.APPROVAL_STATUS_CODE = CLA.APPROVAL_STATUS_CODE (+)

select SURVEY_NUMBER surveyNumber, SERIAL_NO accessionSerialNo, ACCESSION_NUMBER accessionNo, TO_CHAR(COLLECTION_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') collectionDate, TEST_TYPE_CD4 cd4, TEST_TYPE_RES genotypicResistance, TEST_TYPE_HIV_IMM hivImmunoassay, TEST_TYPE_SUPP_IMM supImmunoassay, TEST_TYPE_HIV_NAT hivNAT, TEST_TYPE_CUL cluture, TEST_TYPE_OTH other, REPORTED_IN_NYEHMS resultRptNyehms, RESOLVED resolved, TO_CHAR(DATE_RESOLVED, 'MM/DD/YYYY') dateResolved, COMMENTS comments, LAFT_STAFF laftStaff from LAFT_CLEP_AUDIT_ACCESSION_DATA where SURVEY_NUMBER = #{surveyNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE LAFT_CLEP_AUDIT_ACCESSION_DATA SET ACCESSION_NUMBER = #{accessionVO.accessionNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COLLECTION_DATE = FN_TO_DATE(#{accessionVO.collectionDate,jdbcType=DATE},'MM/DD/YYYY'), TEST_TYPE_HIV_IMM = #{accessionVO.hivImmunoassay,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TEST_TYPE_HIV_NAT = #{accessionVO.hivNAT,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TEST_TYPE_CD4 = #{accessionVO.cd4,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TEST_TYPE_CUL = #{accessionVO.cluture,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TEST_TYPE_SUPP_IMM = #{accessionVO.supImmunoassay,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TEST_TYPE_RES = #{accessionVO.genotypicResistance,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TEST_TYPE_OTH = #{accessionVO.other,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, REPORTED_IN_NYEHMS = #{accessionVO.resultRptNyehms,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, RESOLVED = #{accessionVO.resolved,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DATE_RESOLVED = FN_TO_DATE(#{accessionVO.dateResolved,jdbcType=DATE},'MM/DD/YYYY'), COMMENTS = #{accessionVO.comments,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, LAFT_STAFF = #{accessionVO.laftStaff,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE SURVEY_NUMBER = #{surveyNumber} and SERIAL_NO = #{accessionSerialNo}

insert into LAFT_CLEP_AUDIT_SURVEY_UPLOAD (PFI, CLIA, LAB_NAME, SURVEY_BEGIN_DATE, SURVEY_END_DATE,CLEP_FILE_NAME,FILE_UPLOAD_BY, FILE_UPLOAD_DATE)
select #{clepHIVSurveyData.PFI, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{clepHIVSurveyData.CLIA,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{clepHIVSurveyData.LAB_NAME,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FN_TO_DATE(#{clepHIVSurveyData.SURVEY_BEGIN_DATE,jdbcType=DATE},'MM/DD/YYYY'), FN_TO_DATE(#{clepHIVSurveyData.SURVEY_END_DATE,jdbcType=DATE},'MM/DD/YYYY'), #{clepHIVSurveyData.fileName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{clepHIVSurveyData.userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE from dual
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LAFT_CLEP_AUDIT_SURVEY_UPLOAD WHERE CLEP_FILE_NAME = #{uploadFilename}
select distinct CLEP_FILE_NAME, FILE_UPLOAD_BY, TO_CHAR(FILE_UPLOAD_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') FILE_UPLOAD_DATE from LAFT_CLEP_AUDIT_SURVEY_UPLOAD

select u.PFI_UPLOAD_PK, u.PFI, u.CLIA, u.LAB_NAME, To_Char(u.SURVEY_BEGIN_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') SURVEY_BEGIN_DATE, To_Char(u.SURVEY_END_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') SURVEY_END_DATE, u.ASSIGNED_STAFF_ID, To_Char(u.ASSIGNED_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') ASSIGNED_DATE, u.ASSIGNED_BY, To_Char(u.SURVEY_CLOSE_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') SURVEY_CLOSE_DATE, u.SURVEY_CLOSE_BY, u.COMMENTS, CASE WHEN u.SURVEY_NUMBER != 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AUDIT_FORM_RECEIVED, NVL(u.SURVEY_NUMBER, 0) SURVEY_NUMBER, To_Char(f.RECEIVE_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') RECEIVE_DATE, CLEP_FILE_NAME, FILE_UPLOAD_BY, To_Char(FILE_UPLOAD_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') FILE_UPLOAD_DATE from LAFT_CLEP_AUDIT_SURVEY_UPLOAD u, LAFT_CLEP_AUDIT_SURVEY_FORM f where u.SURVEY_NUMBER = f.SURVEY_NUMBER (+)
and CLEP_FILE_NAME = #{uploadedFilename}

select PFI_UPLOAD_PK uploadNumber, SURVEY_NUMBER surveyNumber, CLEP_FILE_NAME clepFilename, To_Char(FILE_UPLOAD_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') clepFilUploadDate, FILE_UPLOAD_BY clepFilUploadBy, PFI labPfi, CLIA labClia, LAB_NAME labName, To_Char(SURVEY_BEGIN_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') surveyBeginDate, To_Char(SURVEY_END_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') surveyEndDate, COMMENTS comments , ASSIGNED_STAFF_ID assignedStaffId, To_Char(ASSIGNED_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') assignedDate, ASSIGNED_BY assignedBy, To_Char(SURVEY_CLOSE_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') surveyCloseDate, SURVEY_CLOSE_BY surveyCloseBy from LAFT_CLEP_AUDIT_SURVEY_UPLOAD where PFI_UPLOAD_PK = #{uploadNo}

SELECT a.survey_number, a.pfi, b.clia, b.lab_name, c.approval_status_desc, a.inst_based_reportable_hiv, a.lab_uses_eclrs, a.recruit_assess_staff_assign, TO_CHAR(a.recruit_assess_date_assign, 'MM/DD/YYYY') recruit_assess_date_assign, d.recruit_assess_outcome_desc, a.recruit_assess_comments, TO_CHAR(a.recruit_assess_date_complete, 'MM/DD/YYYY') recruit_assess_date_complete, a.recruit_assess_staff_complete FROM laft_clep_audit_survey_form a JOIN lab_physical_facility b ON b.pfi = a.pfi LEFT OUTER JOIN coded_lab_approval_status c ON Nvl(b.approval_status_code, 0) = c.approval_status_code LEFT OUTER JOIN coded_lab_recruit_assess_outcome d ON Nvl(a.recruit_assess_outcome , 0) = d.recruit_assess_outcome WHERE (a.inst_based_reportable_hiv = 'Y' OR a.lab_uses_eclrs = 'Y') AND Nvl(b.approval_status_code, 2) IN (2, 4, 5) ORDER BY survey_number DESC

select SURVEY_NUMBER surveyNumber, ls.PFI userEnteredPfi, lpf.CLIA pfiLabClia, lpf.LAB_NAME pfiLabName, CLA.APPROVAL_STATUS_DESC pfiLabApprovalStatus, INST_BASED_REPORTABLE_HIV insBasedHivTest, LAB_USES_ECLRS rptNysDohByEclrs, RECRUIT_ASSESS_STAFF_ASSIGN recruitAssessStaffAssign, RECRUIT_ASSESS_STAFF_ASSIGN_BY recruitAssessStaffAssignBy, TO_CHAR(RECRUIT_ASSESS_DATE_ASSIGN, 'MM/DD/YYYY') recruitAssessDateAssign, RECRUIT_ASSESS_OUTCOME recruitAssessOutcome, RECRUIT_ASSESS_COMMENTS recruitAssessComments, TO_CHAR(RECRUIT_ASSESS_DATE_COMPLETE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') recruitAssessDateComplete, RECRUIT_ASSESS_STAFF_COMPLETE recruitAssessStaffComplete, REVIEW_COMPLETED reviewCompleted, REVIEW_COMPLETED_BY reviewCompletedBy, TO_CHAR(REVIEW_COMPLETED_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') reviewCompletedDate from LAFT_CLEP_AUDIT_SURVEY_FORM ls, lab_physical_facility lpf, CODED_LAB_APPROVAL_STATUS cla where ls.SURVEY_NUMBER = #{surveyNo} and ls.pfi = lpf.pfi and LPF.APPROVAL_STATUS_CODE = CLA.APPROVAL_STATUS_CODE (+)
mapper.update: UPDATE LAFT_CLEP_AUDIT_SURVEY_FORM SET INST_BASED_REPORTABLE_HIV = #{insBasedHivTest,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, LAB_USES_ECLRS = #{rptNysDohByEclrs,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, LAB_USES_REF_LAB = #{labRefLabForTest,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, REFERENCE_PFI = upper(#{labRefPFI,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), LAST_UPDATE_BY = upper(#{clepUserId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE SURVEY_NUMBER = #{surveyNumber}
